title: Enrollment Entry Matrix — Residential Natural Gas Supply
content:
A Residential Natural Gas Supply plan may be sold only to a premise and a customer that meet the plan's entry terms below.

| Plan | Premise class served | Gas service required at the premise | States offered | Open to assistance program customers: a customer in a utility customer assistance program may enroll | Enrollment channels | Rescission window after the utility's enrollment confirmation (calendar days) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Beacon Ridge Gas Monthly Variable | residential | Yes | PA, OH, IL, MD | No | phone, web, mail | 10 |
| Beacon Ridge Gas Capped Variable 12 | residential | Yes | PA, OH, IL, MD | No | phone, web, mail | 10 |
| Beacon Ridge Gas Price Lock 12 | residential | Yes | PA, OH, IL, MD | Yes | phone, web, mail | 10 |
| Beacon Ridge Gas Price Lock 24 | residential | Yes | PA, OH, IL, MD | No | phone, web, mail | 10 |
| Beacon Ridge Gas Price Lock 36 | residential | Yes | PA, OH, IL, MD | No | phone, web, mail | 10 |
| Beacon Ridge Carbon Offset Gas 12 | residential | Yes | PA, OH, IL, MD | No | phone, web, mail | 10 |
| Beacon Ridge Carbon Offset Gas 24 | residential | Yes | PA, OH, IL, MD | No | phone, web, mail | 10 |

### Matrix notes

- **Assistance program customers.** Beacon Ridge Gas Price Lock 12 is the only plan open to a customer enrolled in a utility customer assistance program; the other six plans read "No".
- **States.** Every plan is offered in Pennsylvania (PA), Ohio (OH), Illinois (IL) and Maryland (MD). A state outside that list is not offered any Residential Natural Gas Supply plan.
- **Channels.** Every plan may be enrolled by phone, on the web or by mail.
- **Rescission window.** On every plan the window is 10 calendar days after the date of the gas utility's enrollment confirmation.
